opening.argument: The presenter openly promotes a Bitcoin opportunity rather than offering detached technology instruction. He identifies his activity as promotion of a particular offer, then explains how copied videos can carry a promoter's personal message and referral link to prospective participants. He also describes inserting the promoter's information directly into reused video content. These are instructions for directing viewers toward the offer, not merely explaining software. The promoted paid mining-pool participation is presented as a source of recurring income, including a claim of payment for the next 100 days after obtaining a unit. The speaker's repeated encouragement to promote the offer and help people join makes the presentation an endorsement and recruitment funnel rather than neutral instruction.
